lead: California's attorney general opened the day with a [subpoena to OpenAI](../summaries/ad3c0229edf6.md) over its cybersecurity incidents, joining the FTC probe. [Anthropic urged Australia to adopt an opt-out copyright model](../summaries/170d39a07a6c.md), and a [test of OpenAI's Luna](../summaries/7dea3bdfc475.md) found its 99% confidence was right only 68% of the time. [OpenAI added virtual try-on to ChatGPT](../summaries/cdc20ea0697d.md).

sections.title: California joins the OpenAI probe
sections.intro: California's attorney general subpoenas OpenAI over the hacking incidents, three OpenAI staff leave over mishandled information, and SoftBank and Nvidia finish their $10B investments.

sections.title: Copyright and the news business
sections.intro: Anthropic asks Australia for an opt-out regime while the ABC warns of cannibalisation, and two opinion pieces push back on AI hype and fatigue.

sections.title: Models and a shaky confidence number
sections.intro: A test finds OpenAI's Luna is right only 68% of the time when 99% sure, Microsoft ships streaming transcription, FLUX 3 Image appears and DoGBench tops out under 50%.

sections.title: Shopping, pricing and consumer ChatGPT
sections.intro: ChatGPT gets try-on and Favorites, McDonald's pricing raises questions and Sites in ChatGPT shows up.

sections.title: Small tools and side projects
sections.intro: An assembly editor, a solo-built C compiler that boots Linux, an idea red-teamer, a messaging layer for agents and two odd web projects.

sections.title: Politics, export controls and rogue-agent rhetoric
sections.intro: Jay Clayton may become AI czar, Nvidia chips keep reaching China and LeCun dismisses the rogue-agent scare.

sections.title: arXiv, tools and an ethics warning
sections.intro: arXiv caps submissions at two a month, a post warns against torturing models and MonoCode wraps coding agents.

sections.title: Money, data centers and chips
sections.intro: Amazon pledges $1B to data center towns, Halluminate raises $30M, a Nvidia smuggling arrest and Suno launches Speech.

sections.title: Opinion, essays and where agents are going
sections.intro: Mollick on agent swarms, four complaints about agentic coding, Zitron on the economy and more.

sections.title: Tools, benchmarks and open releases
sections.intro: A retrieval benchmark, Strands Decider, Olmo-core 3, an AI that beats Stratego and a batch of Show HN tools.

sections.title: Infrastructure, money and robots
sections.intro: Oracle's power delay, $60B of chip financing, Google's satellite and Figure retires a robot.

sections.title: Safety, Apple and a Slovenian domain rush
sections.intro: OpenAI cuts three safety researchers, Apple tightens Full Disk Access and .si registrations spike.
